title: The Age Step Added to an Arrears Settlement Figure, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
The longer a crop input account has stood past due, the greater the further share of the settlement base added to what the member must remit.

**Clause.** Where the account has stood past due for more than 90 days, counted from the date it went past due as day zero to the handling date, the further share added is 15 percent. Where the account has stood past due for more than 45 days but not more than 90, counted the same way, the further share added is 8 percent. In every other case no further share is added for the age of the arrears on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

| Days the account has stood past due, counted from the date it went past due as day zero to the handling date | Further share of the settlement base added |
| --- | --- |
| more than 90 | 15 percent |
| more than 45, up to and including 90 | 8 percent |
| 45 or fewer | No further share |

Both bands read strictly past their day: at 90 days the account sits in the lower band and at 91 in the upper, while at 45 days no further share is added and at 46 the lower band is reached. An account that has not stood past due at all carries no further share.
